By finalizing your order, you acknowledge and accept complete responsibility for the order post-delivery. Please note, orders that include alcohol or certain restricted items might not qualify for doorstep delivery and will be taken back to the store if you are not present to receive them.

roleSwitchingPolicy.introDescription: Please be aware of the following
roleSwitchingPolicy.accountAccessDescription: This app supports multiple functionalities, including those of Driver, Buy Food, Vendor and Ride Share. Your account grants access to these sections, each with distinct features and purposes. Ensure you are using the correct account for the desired service.
roleSwitchingPolicy.dataSyncDescription: Switching between sections may temporarily affect the synchronization of your data. For example, any pending orders, driver requests or sales may be affected during the transition. We recommend completing any ongoing tasks before switching.
roleSwitchingPolicy.featureAvailabilityDescription: Each section of the app offers specific features tailored to your role—Driver, Buy Food, Vendor or Ride Share. When switching, you will have access to tools and information relevant to your current role. Please ensure you are familiar with the functions and requirements of the section you are accessing.
roleSwitchingPolicy.securityPrivacyDescription: Your personal and account information remains secure, regardless of the section you're using. However, it is crucial to maintain the confidentiality of your login credentials and account details at all times.
roleSwitchingPolicy.supportAssistanceDescription: If you encounter any issues or have questions about using the app in any section, please contact our support team for assistance.
roleSwitchingPolicy.closing: Thank you for using our app. We strive to provide a seamless experience, whether you're using the Driver, Buy Food, Vendor or Ride Share sections.
